question: What is the mascot of the first Khelo India Water Sports Festival?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Himalayan Kingfisher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Khelo India Water Sports Festival Mascot, Logo unveiled in Srinagar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**First-ever** **Khelo India Water Sports Festival (KIWSF)** announced.

 
 
• 
 
**Logo** depicts **Shikara on Dal Lake** with **snow-capped mountains** and **pine trees**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mascot**: **Himalayan Kingfisher**.

 
 
• 
 
Venue: **Dal Lake**, **Srinagar**.

 
 
• 
 
Over **400 athletes** from **36 states & UTs** to participate.

 
 
• 
 
Events: **Rowing**, **Canoeing**, and **Kayaking**.

 
 
• 
 
Hosted by **J&K Sports Council** with **Union Ministry of Youth Affairs**.
